correctness.rationale: Exact weighted-walk matrix expansion yields all entries. At opposite-part edges the quadratic discriminant is bounded by -(5d_i²+2d_id_j+5d_j²)/12<0, so those entries are positive. At same-part distance-two pairs the root is exactly 3m/c with permanent negative sign afterward. Every diagonal cubic decreases because each spectral term has derivative -λ(1-hλ+(hλ)²/2) and positive-eigenvalue mass. This proves exact nonreentrant minimum. SSP convex-combination identity proves lower 1/Δ; max-degree vertex and positive weighted moments prove strict α/Δ; cycle and stars establish sharpness. Exact-rational replay verified 486 examples and 178505 entry checks; finite samples are not the proof.

value.rationale: For arbitrary heterogeneous positive conductances, local degree and two-walk statistics replace full matrix-polynomial scanning while identifying which transition loses positivity and permanently stays negative. The sharp universal improvement interval over forward Euler, extremizing four-cycle and star geometries, and separate diagonal/distance-two failure channels give actionable structure, not a single arbitrary numeric example. The statement does not claim solution accuracy or nonlinear SSP beyond its precise endpoint domain.
